patches.name: Uncensor patch
patches.notes: Install (PC): Download the patch from the link below. Once you have downloaded the file, locate the steam directory for the game (right click on the game in Steam, Properties, Local Files, Browse Local Files...). Inside that directory, there will be a folder named 'game'. To apply the patch, copy the contents of the patch zip-file to that directory. Overwrite any existing files if prompted. It's working if: It says 'Uncensored Edition' (instead of 'Steam Version') on the main menu of the game. uncensorpat.ch checked this patch on PC.
